differences.title: Duplicate keyboardBacklightStates key in legacy serializer
differences.legacy_defect: Legacy serializer emitted duplicate keys for keyboardBacklightStates, causing strict JSON parsers to reject or overwrite data.
differences.rust_target_behavior: Serializes unique, validated keyboardBacklightStates keys with round-trip regression tests.

differences.title: Missing SetWebcam method on D-Bus
differences.legacy_defect: Legacy exposed WebcamSWAvailable and GetWebcamSWStatus but lacked SetWebcam method for toggling webcam hardware state over D-Bus.
differences.rust_target_behavior: Implement typed SetWebcam(b) -> b method on D-Bus while retaining legacy query compatibility.

differences.title: GNOME extension GetKeyboardBacklightControlEnabled vs Supported mismatch
differences.legacy_defect: GNOME extension called non-existent D-Bus method GetKeyboardBacklightControlEnabled instead of the actual method GetKeyboardBacklightControlSupported.
differences.rust_target_behavior: Correctly call GetKeyboardBacklightControlSupported and separate hardware capability from active backlight brightness state.

differences.title: False positive bool return code on write errors
differences.legacy_defect: Legacy methods occasionally returned true even when underlying sysfs write failed or device IO returned error.
differences.rust_target_behavior: Return explicit Result<bool, Error> or false on write failures, never reporting success when hardware writes fail.

differences.title: YCbCr / YUV420 parsing quirk on empty destination vector
differences.legacy_defect: Settings parser looped over display modes assuming non-empty vector, causing parsing edge cases when checking force YUV420 output switches.
differences.rust_target_behavior: Guard against empty display mode lists and safely parse color formats.

differences.title: Client wrapper collapsing D-Bus transport and auth errors into boolean false
differences.legacy_defect: Legacy UccdClient wrapped D-Bus method calls with callMethod<bool>(...).value_or(false), masking connection loss, Polkit denials, timeouts, and invalid signatures as a generic false return.
differences.rust_target_behavior: Expose Result<bool, zbus::Error> in typed proxies and CLI to distinguish logical rejection (Ok(false)) from communication, authorization, or timeout failures (Err).

differences.title: Hidden hardcoded 1500 ms async call timeout in AsyncRead
differences.legacy_defect: Legacy AsyncRead.hpp enforced a hardcoded 1500 ms timeout via asyncCall(message, 1500), causing silent telemetry drop on slow EC or sysfs responses.
differences.rust_target_behavior: Use Tokio async background sampling with lockless snapshot caching (ADR-02), eliminating blocking D-Bus timeouts on sensor telemetry reads.

differences.title: Daemon returning boolean false on malformed JSON or authorization failure instead of D-Bus error reply
differences.legacy_defect: Legacy UccDBusService returned bool false for malformed JSON, out-of-bounds parameters, or failed Polkit checks, treating error conditions as valid replies containing false.
differences.rust_target_behavior: Return typed zbus::fdo::Error or structured Result on validation/authorization failure while maintaining backwards wire compatibility where callers require boolean return.

differences.title: Dual D-Bus interface alias registered concurrently on primary and legacy paths
differences.legacy_defect: Legacy daemon was configured either under com.uniwill.uccd or de.uniwill.uccd depending on compile-time flags and system symlinks, causing interface errors for clients expecting the alternative namespace.
differences.rust_target_behavior: Concurrently register both com.uniwill.uccd and de.uniwill.uccd on /com/uniwill/uccd and /de/uniwill/uccd paths via register_uccd_service, providing seamless compatibility for both modern and legacy clients without configuration.

differences.title: Normalized 0..4 pump speed step table mapping vs raw wire voltage codes
differences.legacy_defect: Legacy table speed columns directly referenced discrete hardware codes where 1 was 12V (which is strictly forbidden on LCT coolers), creating confusion between curve steps and raw voltage values.
differences.rust_target_behavior: Fan profiles define pump curve levels 0..=4 (0=Off, 1=7V, 2=8V, 3=11V, 4=12V forbidden) translated through bidirectional translators pump_speed_to_voltage and voltage_to_pump_speed in ucc-core::fan, with CoolerPacketEncoder strictly rejecting 12V.
